product_metadata.title: Th3mys Tree Branch Valance for Windows Botanical Pattern Rod Pocket Window Curtain Valance for Living Room Bedroom Kitchen 52 by 18 Inch Gray
features: PACKAGE : One valance. Extremely soft to the touch.
Fabric Content : Made with 100-percent polyester textured high quality fabric creates a smooth draping effect, soft feel.
SIZE : 52"W x 18"L. 3"Rod Pocket slides easily onto your curtain rod for quick installation.
DESIGN : This versatile curtain valance provides an easy and inexpensive way to add color and style to any room of your home.
CARE INSTRUCTION: Machine Wash Cold, Gentle Cycle in mesh bag, only non-chlorine bleach when needed, tumble dry low, cool iron if needed.
description: This unique gray tree branch botanic pattern thermal insulated rod pocket top drape with abstract and modern aesthetics provides a classic elegant look, perfect for living room, bedroom, dining room, kids room or any indoor and outdoor space of your home. These curtains allows some light to filter through, build a soft mood while still providing you privacy.
Easy to care and clean, these valances are machine washable in cold water, gentle cycle, do not bleach, tumble dry low, cool iron if needed.
